title: Fotografische Gestaltung
slide_intent: Make the important decisions during photography so editing reinforces a credible scene.
strategic_value: Deliberate perspective and framing can create a distinctive DB look from real situations.
demonstration: Six captioned photographs illustrate perspective, composition, proximity/distance, cropping, detail and scale.
practical_value: Plan viewpoint, subject distance and frame before relying on postproduction.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text aims to develop the look from the actual situation rather than create it in postproduction.
reference_purposes.Application: Six examples identify controllable photographic decisions.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source says editing supports those decisions and does not replace them.
